title: AI Standup & Sync Platform
description: A modern, AI-powered daily standup and meeting synchronization platform utilizing Anthropic's Claude AI for automated summaries and blockers tracking.

problem.title: The Challenge
problem.content: Building a reliable real-time syncing mechanism using WebSockets across a scalable Next.js and NestJS architecture, while integrating Anthropic's Claude AI for accurate and context-aware summarization of team chat and standup updates.

solution.title: Our Approach
solution.content: Separated the architecture into a Next.js 16 frontend (App Router) and a dedicated NestJS backend to handle WebSocket connections efficiently. Utilized the Anthropic SDK to process natural language standups and generate structured summaries and blocker highlights. Leveraged Turborepo for lightning-fast builds and pnpm workspaces for managing dependencies across the apps/web, apps/api, and packages/shared directories.

impact.title: Business Impact
impact.content: Automated the tedious task of reading daily updates, saving an estimated 2 hours per week for engineering managers, while establishing a highly scalable and maintainable codebase ready for enterprise adoption.

results.title: Key Results
results.content:
- **Real-time Collaboration** via WebSocket architecture
- **AI-Powered Summaries** using Anthropic's Claude AI
- **Fast Builds** leveraging Turborepo monorepo structure
- **Scalable Monorepo** managing shared TypeScript packages seamlessly

techStack.name: NestJS
